resources.string: No vault on the list yet. Choose the folder that holds a KDBX vault you already have, or create a new vault.
KeyNexa will stop showing "%1$s" in this list. The vault file is not deleted: it stays where it is.
That file could not be read. Try another one.
Opening. this can take a few seconds.
That password or key file does not open this vault. Check them and try again.
That key file is not valid. Choose another one.
This file is not a KDBX vault.
This vault uses a format KeyNexa does not support yet.
This file looks damaged or is still being synchronised. Wait a moment and try again: KeyNexa has not changed it.
Your device does not have enough memory to open this vault. Lower the vault's Argon2 memory in another program (for example KeePassXC) and try again.
This file cannot be read. It may have been moved, or the permission to read it may have been revoked.
Your changes are still here and in a private encrypted copy. Nothing has been lost.
The file changed on another device, and this version cannot be merged with it yet.
The file changed on another device, and the two versions cannot be combined safely.
The file changed again while saving. Saving once more will merge the newest version.
The file on storage looks damaged or is still being copied, so KeyNexa has not written to it.
This vault no longer opens with the credentials in use; another device may have changed them.
KeyNexa could not build the encrypted file for this vault.
The storage refused to write the file: permission, space or a provider failure.
The file does not hold exactly what KeyNexa wrote, so the save is not trusted.
Unsaved changes from your previous session were found.
This vault has no entries yet.
